en.title: Descendants Franchise Welcomes Hidden Heroes to Disney+ and Disney Channel in 2026
en.summary: Get ready for a new chapter in the world of Auradon and beyond! Disney is expanding its popular Descendants universe with a brand-new series, Hidden Heroes, set to debut on Disney+ and Disney Channel.
en.body:
The magic of Auradon is set to expand with **Hidden Heroes: A Descendants Story**, a brand-new television series officially ordered by Disney+ and Disney Channel. Set to arrive in 2026, this latest installment promises to dive deeper into the expansive universe established by the hit films, focusing on a new generation of characters tied to the iconic sidekicks of fairytale lore. While details are still emerging, the series is confirmed to be an original story within the Descendants saga, distinct from any prior films or projects with similar titles, such as the 2015 thriller "Hidden."

The Descendants franchise has consistently captivated audiences by reimagining classic fairytale characters and their offspring, exploring themes of destiny, choice, and identity. **Hidden Heroes** will undoubtedly continue this tradition, offering a fresh perspective by centering the narrative around the children of characters who have traditionally played supporting roles. This strategic choice allows for the exploration of new dynamics and conflicts within the established world, potentially introducing viewers to the untold stories and legacies of figures like Lumiere, Sebastian, or even Mushu.

## A New Generation of Heroes and Villains

The official announcement has also revealed the full cast poised to bring these new characters to life. While specific character names and their fairytale parentage are yet to be fully detailed, the ensemble cast promises a vibrant mix of fresh faces and familiar talents. The series is expected to build upon the established lore of Auradon Prep and the Isle of the Lost, potentially exploring new locations and introducing a fresh set of challenges for its young protagonists. Fans are eager to see how these new heroes and heroines navigate their legacies, forging their own paths separate from the shadow of their famous parents and the conflicts that have defined the franchise so far.

## What This Means for Descendants Fans

For the dedicated fanbase of the **Descendants** franchise, **Hidden Heroes** represents a significant expansion of the narrative universe they've come to love. The focus on sidekick children offers a compelling new angle, moving beyond the established children of villains and heroes to explore a different facet of the fairytale kingdom. This move is likely to reignite interest among long-time viewers and attract new audiences with a fresh premise. The anticipation is palpable as fans speculate about which sidekicks will be featured and what kind of adventures await these new characters. The success of this series could pave the way for further explorations within the Descendants world, potentially leading to spin-offs or interconnected stories.

## What's Next

With a 2026 release window, **Hidden Heroes: A Descendants Story** is still in the early stages of development. Fans can anticipate further casting announcements and plot details to be revealed in the coming months as production gears up. Keep an eye on official Disney channels for more magical updates.
